title: UTR Rating Goal Adherence by Season
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utr:rating
| stats avg(rating_value) as actual count as sessions by season
| eval pct_of_goal=round(100*actual/7.0,1), goal_label="7"
| sort pct_of_goal
description: Compares average UTR rating with a simple target for each season, showing where utr rating is meeting plan and where it is lagging.
value: Splitting target adherence by season shows which contexts are helping you hit the plan and which ones need adjustment.
implementation: Set the target value in the query to match your routine, then review low-adherence season values before the next session block.
visualization: Table of season values with average UTR rating and percent of goal.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which season settings help you hit your target for utr rating and which ones fall short.
